hints: Do you know these numbers? Each one is a number times itself.
121 = 11 × 11 and 100 = 10 × 10. Check 64 and 49 the same way.
The series is 11², 10², ___, 8², 7². The blank is the square that comes between 10² and 8².

steps.action: Check the differences you can see: 121 − 100 = 21 and 64 − 49 = 15. Not the same, so it is not taking away a fixed number.

steps.why: The numbers being squared go down by 1: 11, 10, then 8, 7. So 9 is missing.

steps.action: Check: 100 − 81 = 19 and 81 − 64 = 17. The drops are 21, 19, 17, 15, each 2 less than the last, so 81 fits. The missing number is 81.

trapNotes.79: This takes away 21 again. The drops get 2 smaller each time: 21, then 19.
trapNotes.82: 82 is halfway between 100 and 64. But the drops are not equal (21 at the start, 15 at the end), so the halfway number does not work.
trapNotes.90: This takes 10 away from 100. Check the first drop: 121 − 100 = 21, so the step is not 10.
